user.title: Set up ASHP Zone Control
user.description: Name this integration instance. Zones, rooms, TRVs and sensors are configured afterwards via Configure.

abort.already_configured: An instance with this name already exists.

init.title: Heating zones: {zone_summary}
init.description: Add, edit or remove a zone below, or choose Done to save.

select_rooms.title: Rooms: {zone_name}
select_rooms.description: Choose which Areas belong to this zone. An Area can only belong to one zone — picking it here removes it from any other zone it's currently in.

zone_details.title: Name this zone: {current_name}
zone_details.description: Rooms: {room_summary}. Give the zone a descriptive name (e.g. "Ground Floor") and pick the heating actuator switch(es) it should control — you can select one or several.

room_entities.title: Options: {room_name}
room_entities.description: Zone: {zone_name}. Found {trv_count} TRV(s) and {sensor_count} temperature sensor(s) already assigned to this Area. Untick any that shouldn't be treated as active for this room. Turn the room off entirely below if it shouldn't take part in heating demand at all (e.g. an unoccupied guest room).

data_description.active: When off, this room is skipped entirely and never triggers its zone's heating switch.

abort.no_areas_defined: No Areas are defined in this Home Assistant instance yet. Create at least one Area under Settings → Areas & Zones, then reopen this options flow.
